entities.summary: Tel Megadim is an archaeological site located on the Carmel coast of Israel, about 2 km north of Atlit and 11 km south of Tel Shiqmona (Haifa). Excavations there have uncovered significant Middle Bronze Age IIA structures and a notable Persian period settlement, featuring a kurkar stone altar, diverse imported ceramic wares, and horse-and-rider figurines.
